entities.summary: Michael R. Norris is an American actor. He is the eldest son of actor and martial arts champion Chuck Norris and his first wife, Dianne Holechek. He starred in the 1986 drama film Born American and the 1991 action film Delta Force 3: The Killing Game. He also directed and starred in the 2004 Christian film Birdie & Bogey.
